search_outcome: Reused nine expert calls and prior pharmacy/claims/launch audits. Six targeted queries across switch studies, on-demand-to-LTP and issuer/access disclosures yielded no matched incumbent-origin->PHVS or Rx->paid empirical rates. New primary competitor switch poster supports competition mechanism, not capture magnitude. PMC access blocked; existing saved claims fulltext and primary poster used. Stopped low-yield expansion.
decision: Implement a transparent underwriting grid plus first-commercial-year flow calculation. Numerical prescription/access ranges are analyst assumptions, not fitted data or confidence intervals. No selected fair value or probability-weighted case.
transfer_limits: PHVS rates span entire provisional origin pools; implicit eligibility/reach/choice, not biologically eligible population estimates.
New-starter attrition cannot represent prevalent-user dissatisfaction.
HistoricalOrladeyo entrant history is not immediate origin and not net-growth mix.
Prescription attempts, trial starts, paid/PAP entries and paid patients are distinct metrics.
The model conditions on approval and launch; no clinicalPoS inside adoption.
No evidence establishes low/high scenarios as true bounds; outcomes outside grid possible.
